# SheetJS Community Edition

Pinned version: **0.20.3**, mini browser build, Apache-2.0 ([LICENSE](LICENSE)).

- Source: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.mini.min.js
- SHA-256: `0cb353f830d7288385492c83d277b058ddeac664ca51cf1393aa1fd3e2b70939`
- Loaded locally inside the form-import Web Worker only when an `.xlsx` is selected.
- CSV uses the application's UTF-8 parser. Legacy `.xls`, macros, formula evaluation and Google API integration are not supported.

When updating, obtain the browser build and license from the official SheetJS release, record the version/hash, and check Thai text, formatted dates, blank cells and multiple sheets before release.
